summary_zh: 投稿方已逐路径自查当前分发包：自有内容 CC BY 4.0、自有代码 MIT；OSM 衍生数据库单独 ODbL；Noto Sans SC 子集按 OFL 1.1 嵌入 PDF 与离线 HTML；第三方引用与仓库临时输入不被重新许可；模型生成媒体已清退。该清单是投稿方自查，不冒充独立法律审计。
summary_en: The contributor has inventoried every current distribution path: contributor-owned content is CC BY 4.0, contributor-owned code is MIT, the OSM-derived database remains separately ODbL, Noto Sans SC subsets are embedded in PDF and offline HTML under OFL 1.1, third-party citations and repository provisional inputs are not relicensed, and generated media has been removed. This is a contributor inventory, not an independent legal audit.

components.scope: Contributor-owned narrative, tables, diagrams, SVG, PNG exports, editorial layout, authored JSON and conceptual GeoJSON transformations
Contributor-authored build, replay and offline interaction code
Repository-provided provisional boundary and key-area inputs
components.limit: Not an official redline or approval basis.

components.scope: Linked policies, standards, cases and public webpages
components.limit: No third-party page image, logo, document layout or retrieval cache is redistributed.

components.scope: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular glyph output rasterized into the four final PDFs at build time, plus the WOFF2 subset shared by the four offline HTML outputs through visual/assets/offline-cjk-font.css
components.pdf_render_method: Pillow 12.2.0 deterministic 2x transparent glyph layers plus existing package-authored PNG figures inserted into PyMuPDF 1.27.2.3 pages; font_programs_embedded=false
components.pdf_accessibility_boundary: fixed-page visual publication; searchable text and tagged-PDF conformance are not claimed; the paired offline HTML reports remain the machine-readable keyboard surface
components.html_subset_method: fontTools subset 4.62.1 over the literal character union of both final report and visual HTML counterparts; WOFF2; 1144 Unicode code points; font-display swap

components.scope: Every path in the current submission distribution tree
components.limit: The inventory records provenance and licence decisions but is not an independent legal opinion, trademark search or professional rights audit.

components.scope: Prior optional generated image, video and audio paths

gate_items.required_evidence: versioned authorship and contribution record for every proposed public asset and derivative
applicable CC BY 4.0 and MIT notices, attribution placement and derivative boundaries for the exact release
ODbL attribution, database/produced-work classification, share-alike decision and distribution notice for the exact public output
OFL notice, source/subset identity, reserved-font-name check and embedding or rasterization method for the exact output
item-level reproduction or citation-only decision for every third-party text, image, archive item, oral-history record, person or mark
scope-specific trademark search and professional historical or curatorial verification for final names, logo and landmark content
tool/model, prompt or production method, output terms, edit history, disclosure label and non-evidence statement for each generated public asset
reviewed alt text, caption/transcript, contrast, legibility, tactile/audio or other equivalent access appropriate to the installed medium
named takedown holder, correction route, withdrawal conditions, physical removal plan and archived rights decision

future_public_installation_and_brand_rel.release_rule: A repository review, PR merge, current component licence declaration or contributor inventory does not authorize a public installation, permanent landmark, merchandise, external campaign or professional implementation. All applicable items must be accepted for the exact version and use context.

truth_boundary: Rights clearance does not establish field truth, planning approval, accessibility compliance, service performance, G1 maturity or professional acceptance.
